lookup.name: 最低賃金を下回る労働契約 (contract below the minimum wage)
lookup.message: The wage is below the regional minimum wage in force on the term's first day; such a term is void (最低賃金法 art.4(2)).

references.title: 最低賃金法 arts.4, 7, 13 with 施行規則 arts.1–2: the minimum in force on the term's day (day) of the workplace's prefecture, less a permitted reduction, compared per hour.

lookup.name: Worked beyond 8 hours a day with no 36 agreement in force
lookup.message: Worked beyond 8 hours a day with no 36 agreement in force (労働基準法 arts.32(2), 36(1)).

references.title: 法定労働時間 1日8時間 (労働基準法 art.32(2)); beyond it only under a filed 36 agreement (art.36(1); company.facts.overtime_agreement_from/to) or in an emergency (art.33). Not for managers (art.41(ii)) or a variable, flex or deemed regime (company.facts.working_time_regime). A worked day is a fact to correct, not to refuse: warn.

lookup.name: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force
lookup.message: Worked beyond 40 hours in the week with no 36 agreement in force (労働基準法 arts.32(1), 36(1)).

references.title: 法定労働時間 1週40時間 (労働基準法 art.32(1)), 44 hours for a 特例措置対象事業場 (施行規則 art.25の2; company.facts.weekly_limit_44); the week is the calendar week from company.facts.week_start_day (昭和63年1月1日 基発1号), read on its last day.

lookup.name: A shift planned beyond 8 ordinary hours: its hours beyond 8 are statutory overtime the pay does not price
lookup.message: The planned shift has more than 8 ordinary hours: the hours beyond 8 are statutory overtime the planned day does not price; plan at most 8 ordinary hours and let the rest be overtime (労働基準法 arts.32(2), 37(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.32(2) (8 hours a day) and art.37(1) (割増賃金 on every hour beyond it) and art.24 (full payment): overtime is every hour past the planned shift’s ordinary hours, so ordinary hours planned beyond 8 a day would carry the statutory premium unpriced. Not for managers (art.41(ii)) or a variable, flex or deemed regime (company.facts.working_time_regime).

lookup.name: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8
lookup.message: Too short a break: 45 minutes beyond 6 hours of work, 1 hour beyond 8 (労働基準法 art.34(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.34(1): a break of at least 45 minutes where the working time exceeds 6 hours and 1 hour where it exceeds 8, within the working time; the break is the gaps between the day’s clock intervals, and the working time is the time inside them (not the paid hours, which count the planned hours on a day left early). Not for managers (art.41).

lookup.name: No rest day in the week
lookup.message: No rest day in the week (労働基準法 art.35(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.35(1): at least one rest day each week, unless the work rules use 4 rest days in 4 weeks (art.35(2); company.facts.variable_rest_days). Rest-day work needs a 36 agreement and the 35% premium (arts.36, 37).

lookup.name: Overtime beyond 8 hours or rest-day work recorded for a worker under 18, which the law forbids
lookup.message: Overtime beyond 8 hours a day, or rest-day work, recorded for a worker under 18, which the law forbids (労働基準法 art.60(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.60(1): the 36 agreement (art.36) does not apply to a worker under 18, so no work beyond 8 hours a day or on the statutory rest day; overtime within 8 hours (past a shorter schedule) is lawful. Every hour past the schedule is approved overtime, so recording it is the forbidden instruction and the file is refused (an emergency under art.33 is not distinguished).

lookup.name: A worker under 18 worked beyond 8 hours a day or 40 a week
lookup.message: A worker under 18 worked beyond 8 hours a day or 40 a week (労働基準法 art.60).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.60(1), (3): no variable-hours or 36-agreement extension for a minor beyond the art.60(3) exceptions.

lookup.name: A worker under 18 worked between 22:00 and 05:00
lookup.message: A worker under 18 worked between 22:00 and 05:00 (労働基準法 art.61(1)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.61(1): no night work for a worker under 18, except a male of 16 or over in a shift system (proviso) and the art.61(3)–(4) cases.

lookup.name: Overtime beyond 8 hours or rest-day work recorded for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused
lookup.message: Overtime beyond 8 hours a day, or rest-day work, recorded for a pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused (労働基準法 art.66(2)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.66(2): on the request of an 妊産婦 (terms.facts.pregnancy_work_limits_requested) the employer shall not make her work overtime beyond the statutory hours or on a rest day; every hour past the schedule is approved overtime, so a day beyond 8 hours or rest-day work is refused.

lookup.name: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused worked at night
lookup.message: A pregnant or post-partum worker who asked to be excused worked at night (労働基準法 art.66(3)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.66(3): no night work on the 妊産婦’s request.

lookup.name: Overtime approved for a worker who asked not to work beyond the schedule for childcare or care
lookup.message: Overtime approved for a worker who asked not to work beyond the schedule for childcare or care (育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8, 16の9).

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.16の8–16の9: a worker caring for a child before school age (from April 2025) or a family member who asks (terms.facts.no_overtime_requested) shall not be made to work beyond the scheduled hours: the approval is refused.

lookup.name: A worker who asked to be excused from night work for childcare or care worked between 22:00 and 05:00
lookup.message: A worker who asked to be excused from night work for childcare or care worked between 22:00 and 05:00 (育児・介護休業法 arts.19, 20).

references.title: 育児・介護休業法 arts.19–20 (terms.facts.night_work_exemption_requested)

lookup.name: More than 2 hours of overtime in a day on work harmful to health
lookup.message: More than 2 hours of overtime in a day on work harmful to health (労働基準法 art.36(6)(i)).

references.title: 労働基準法 art.36(6)(i) with 施行規則 art.18: 坑内労働 and the listed harmful work may run at most 2 hours beyond the daily limit, even under a 36 agreement (terms.facts.hazardous_work).

lookup.name: Less rest between the end of one day’s work and the next than the interval the employer applies
lookup.message: Less rest between the end of one day’s work and the next than the interval the employer applies (勤務間インターバル).

references.title: 労働時間等の設定の改善に関する特別措置法 art.2(1) (the employer’s duty to try to secure rest between shifts; company.facts.work_interval_hours, the interval its rules adopt); for drivers the 改善基準告示 (令和4年厚生労働省告示第367号) sets at least 9 hours (company.facts.overtime_sector DRIVER).

lookup.name: Leave recorded on a day with attendance: the leave or the clock times are wrong.
lookup.message: Leave recorded on a day with attendance: the leave or the clock times are wrong.

references.title: 労働基準法 art.39 (annual leave is a release from the duty to work on that day) and art.108 with 施行規則 art.54(1)(ii)–(iii) (the wage ledger records the days and hours worked): a day cannot be both.
